meta: Fake apps asking to read your text messages can read the bank OTP codes sent to you: how to prevent it and what to do.

muc.title: It can read your OTP
muc.text: An app installed from a strange link that asks to read your messages can read the bank OTP codes sent to you.

muc.title: Official app stores only
muc.text: Only download apps from official app stores; never install files sent by message or in chat groups.

muc.title: Asking for too much
muc.text: A flashlight or weather app asking to read messages, contacts or control your screen is very suspicious.

muc.title: Disconnect, uninstall, report
muc.text: If you've installed one, turn off your internet, uninstall it, call your bank to lock your account, and report it to the police.

muc.title: Check an app's permissions
muc.text: Screenshot an app's permission list, send it to a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, and ask which permissions are unnecessary.

thu: Screenshot an app's permission list (hide your account name), send it to a chatbot and ask which permissions are unnecessary.
